text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose $29.19 million in first half of April to $6,350.68 million.
- Budget deficit totalled 1,065 billion Lebanese pounds at end of March.
- Public debt totalled $11.355 billion at end of March.
- Ministry of Labour legalises affiliation of five pro-governmental unions to General Labour Confederation six days before CGTL elections.
- Prime Minister Hariri receives Russia's Deputy Foreign Minister Posovaliok.
- 16 Lebanese slightly injured in haj blaze in Saudi Arabia.
- Moslems' highest clergyman Mufti Kabbani welcomes Pope's visit to Lebanon on May 10.
- U.S. President Clinton says in message to Hariri: "Lebanon will enjoy the fruit of peace as an independent nation."
